Two final corrections were made. A6 now limits its CEU–KDT agreement claim to the comparisons established by the construction. A4 explicitly credits Halpern's automatic rock-throwing machine as an antecedent of the reliability concern applied in Sprinkler. A5's manuscript is unchanged from v9. No theorem statement, displayed equation or appendix proof changed.

The review found no defect requiring withdrawal of A5 or A6. Their surviving contributions are narrower than general theories of belief or information value. A4's central result is a valid restriction on a specified policy class; its significance and originality remain less secure. The final assessment explains these judgments and the remaining source-access limits.

The reports record completed work without reproducing internal run logs or human-input histories. No additional-model review is treated as pending or completed. No contest form has been submitted. E3 remains withdrawn.
